item.title: Legroom 0.9.9
item.description:
Legroom 0.9.9

  • New: Check-up. A plain look at your Mac's built-in defenses (System Integrity, Gatekeeper, FileVault, firewall, XProtect and security updates), the result of Apple's own background malware checks, and everything that opens on its own — grouped by who signed it, with the reason anything is worth a look.
  • Turn off a startup item (its file goes to the Trash, so you can undo it), uninstall the app that owns it, or show it in Finder.
  • Runs only when you click Check Now. No password, no internet, nothing sent anywhere.

item.title: Legroom 0.9.8
item.description:
Legroom 0.9.8

  • Automatic updates. Legroom can now update itself. Use Legroom › Check for Updates…, or turn on automatic checks in Settings.
